reviews.text: OneTechGirl knows what's up! The first thing she did was LISTEN—really listen. That alone set the tone for a smooth, clear collaboration. She instantly understood my needs and aesthetics, then blended them with innovative, responsive design that created a seamless user experience. And don't even get me started on her clever humor—our vibe was so on point, it felt like we'd known each other for years. She introduced me to AI-driven automation that's already saving me time and money. From smart websites to expertly crafted sales funnels to flawless Google My Business management—this woman is the truth. I'm more confident now in running my business and giving my clients top-tier experiences, thanks to her. Honestly… at this point, I think she might be AI. She's a life saver for real. Thank you for your help, Boss!

ai_infrastructure.details_html: The Jobs Booked System connects your website, phone lines, and CRM into one automated pipeline. When a lead calls, fills out a form, or books online, the system captures them instantly, follows up with texts and emails, reactivates your dormant database, and books appointments to your calendar -- all without you lifting a finger. Missed calls get answered by an AI voice agent that sounds human and books on the spot.

steps.title: Strategy + Content

steps.title: Build + Integrate
steps.details: Full website build with Jobs Booked System installed. AI voice agent configured. Booking calendar, CRM, and nurture sequences wired up. Internal QA.

steps.title: Review + Launch
